raw_comment: The graph shows that the majority of the central states experience the worst degree of droughts. I wonder why nearly half of Colorado does not experience drought, especially because it is a central state. I live in Long Island, New York, which according to the graph is severe. This can affect the water quality around the island further impacting fishing and swimming in lakes and other large bodies of water. A catchy headline for the graph could be "Drought crisis in central United States".
